paragraphs: The GLS400d is the current diesel flagship of the GLS range, fitted to the X167 generation from 2019 onwards. It uses the OM656 D29 - a 2.9-litre inline-six diesel with mild-hybrid technology, representing a step on from the older OM642 V6 diesel used in previous-generation GLS models. The OM656 is a different unit entirely from the OM642, with its own character and rebuild requirements - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLS400D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLS400D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
